constraints.name: accent_reservation_state
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['active'::character varying, 'success'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying, 'abandoned'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: evidence_status_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['demonstrated'::character varying, 'partially_demonstrated'::character varying, 'misunderstood'::character varying, 'insufficient_evidence'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: exercise_session_owner
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (session_id, user_id) REFERENCES training_sessions(id, user_id)

constraints.name: homework_lesson_owner
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (lesson_id, user_id) REFERENCES lesson_lifecycles(id, user_id)

constraints.name: homework_status_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['offered'::character varying, 'assigned'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'discussed'::character varying, 'skipped'::character varying, 'unavailable'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: reflection_owner
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (assignment_id, user_id) REFERENCES homework_assignments(id, user_id)

constraints.name: difficulty_bounds
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((speech_rate >= (0.6)::double precision) AND (speech_rate <= (1.15)::double precision)) AND ((duration_seconds >= 30) AND (duration_seconds <= 90)) AND ((information_density >= 1) AND (information_density <= 3))))

constraints.name: onboarding_status_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((onboarding_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['not_started'::character varying, 'in_progress'::character varying, 'profile_saved'::character varying, 'complete'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: profile_details_bounds
constraints.definition: CHECK (((details IS NULL) OR ((details >= (0)::double precision) AND (details <= (1)::double precision))))

constraints.name: profile_inference_bounds
constraints.definition: CHECK (((inference IS NULL) OR ((inference >= (0)::double precision) AND (inference <= (1)::double precision))))

constraints.name: profile_level_count_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((vocabulary_level)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['A2'::character varying, 'B1'::character varying, 'B2'::character varying, 'C1'::character varying])::text[])) AND (completed_attempts >= 0)))

constraints.name: profile_main_idea_bounds
constraints.definition: CHECK (((main_idea IS NULL) OR ((main_idea >= (0)::double precision) AND (main_idea <= (1)::double precision))))

constraints.name: profile_natural_speed_bounds
constraints.definition: CHECK (((natural_speed IS NULL) OR ((natural_speed >= (0)::double precision) AND (natural_speed <= (1)::double precision))))

constraints.name: profile_overall_bounds
constraints.definition: CHECK (((overall IS NULL) OR ((overall >= (0)::double precision) AND (overall <= (1)::double precision))))

constraints.name: profile_vocabulary_bounds
constraints.definition: CHECK (((vocabulary IS NULL) OR ((vocabulary >= (0)::double precision) AND (vocabulary <= (1)::double precision))))

constraints.name: lesson_exercise_owner
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (lesson_id, user_id) REFERENCES lesson_lifecycles(id, user_id)

constraints.name: lesson_status_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['active'::character varying, 'paused'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'expired'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: session_completion_valid
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((status)::text = 'active'::text) AND (completed_at IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = 'completed'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL))))
